reviews.text: Where do I start?! We had a nightmare flood in our home that ended up being far more expansive than we originally thought. Konner and his team were so patient with us and walked us through the insurance process. They were able to advocate for us with the insurance company while also pushing to keep things moving for our family (4 small kids). We did add some upgrades in the process and they turned out great! Would 100% recommend Jopco to anyone. Great people and work.

Jopco is a top-rated roofing and home improvement contractor known for their fantastic work and exceptional service. They are highly responsive, reliable, and trustworthy, making them the ideal choice for your next project.

Jopco took care of my roof replacement and addressed several home exterior renovations, leaving my house looking new again. Their commitment to customer satisfaction is clear, and I can’t thank them enough!

Konner was professional, knowledgeable, and kept us updated every step of the way. The crew worked efficiently, the quality of the workmanship was excellent, and everything was cleaned up perfectly afterward. Our home looks fantastic, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. Highly recommend Jopco and Konner for anyone needing roof or gutter work

The Jopco team did a truly outstanding job from start to finish! They replaced the roofing and gutters, repaired and repainted the siding, re-stained our porch and fence, and handled interior painting—all with great attention to detail and professionalism. Everything looks fantastic, and the work was completed on time and with care. Highly recommended crew!

Konner and the crew were first rate.  They helped with convincing the insurance company to replace the roof.  They were punctual and kept us in the loop all throughout the process.  On roofing day the were careful and thoroughly  pickup all of the trash from the job.  I cannot recommend them enough.

Jopco was absolutely fantastic. Always attentive to detail and honest and open about pricing. We could not have made a better choice for our major renovations, 100% would refer them to anyone with full confidence.

Had some roof damage after a recent storm and Jopco repaired our roof the very next day. They were quick to respond, matched the shingles and patched it perfectly. Definitely recommend!

Awesome experience taking care of a renovation for us. They took a home in desperate need of an renovation and transformed it for us quickly. High quality work was done at a great price. Could not have asked for better communication and direction from Konner and team.

Jopco replaced my roof after the storm damage this spring. They helped me appeal when my insurance company first declined to replace the entire roof. Ultimately the insurance company did agree to replace the entire roof. Jopco was professional, came when they said they would, did what they said they would, and I now have a new roof! I highly recommend them!

I had very good experience working with Konner and Jopco Construction since 2018. They fixed the roof minor damages caused by a recent wind storm in my area. They thoroughly explained the repair process, provided a fair and transparent estimate. Their crew was skilled, and courteous, ensuring the work was completed on time and with high-quality craftsmanship.

I would highly recommend to anyone in need of roof repairs or construction services. They exceeded my expectations in every way!

They listened to our thoughts and ideas; gave feedback so that we can make informed decisions with changes we made.  The remodel turned out amazing.  We highly recommend Jopco for all your remodel needs.

Jopco, a team of Duo (Konner and Josef) are great to work with. They did a fantastic job on our two houses. Very professional, punctual, and responsive. Jopco did an amazing job. Super professional, easy to communicate with, and everything looks perfect. Highly recommend!

The entire process was smooth, and their expertise made a big difference. Highly recommend their services!

Great company, not one to do the bare minimum but goes the extra mile, works and fights for you when it comes to insurance claims, picks up the phone, great on updating and letting you know all of the process! Chose Jopco.

My experience with other contractors over the years had left me skeptical and dissatisfied, often feeling I had been taken advantage of. But not so with JOPCO.

I highly recommend Jopco Construction to anyone looking for a professional and reliable contractor.
